data.body:
RESOLVED — AC4 satisfied, with causal proof.

Change 2558 MERGED. The box has recovered and is tracking main again.

## The deploy that failed and the deploy that worked differ by exactly this fix

- Last FAILED deploy, `4a5a95531ee5` (fail #5, backoff 900s at 06:38:19): `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp:90` = `COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest`.
- First SUCCESSFUL deploy, `3e04025b684e`: same line, now `COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.12.7`.

Journal at 06:41:01: `mcp cutover complete: /mcp upstream now 127.0.0.1:8092 (deploy DONE; not waiting on in-flight drain)`. The very next deploy attempt after the pin landed succeeded, after five consecutive failures on the floating tag.

## Verified on the box

- `/etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` -> `server 127.0.0.1:8092;`
- `docker ps` -> `rebar-mcp-3e04025b684e-8092 Up 3 minutes (healthy)` — note the container reports HEALTHY, and the nginx upstream now names the port of a LIVE container rather than a dead one.
- Externally: `https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp` returns **401** (auth required) instead of 502 — the upstream is answering. `/review/health` and `/` remain 200.
- Root disk 44G/60G = 73%.

## AC status

- AC1 (no floating tag in container builds) — DONE, landed.
- AC2 (single-sourced, drift impossible or gated) — DONE via the extended `scripts/check_uv_pin.py`, which runs in `make lint` and on every commit.
- AC3 (gate fails on a floating `:latest` for a version-sensitive toolchain image) — DONE, with the assertions proven to bind under a detection-disabling mutant.
- AC4 (box confirmed tracking main again) — DONE, evidence above.

One deliberate carry-over, unchanged: `docker-compose.langfuse.yml:113` still runs `minio:latest`. Same defect class, out of this gate's scope (a compose `image:` key rather than a Dockerfile), lower blast radius, and awaiting an operator decision on the version to pin.
